description: This file defines the LoginActivity class for handling user login UI and logic within an Android application. It manages user input, performs authentication via a repository, and navigates to the main activity upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginActivity
classes.description: An activity managing user login UI, handling input validation, triggering authentication, and navigation upon success.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up view binding, and configures the sign-in button click listener.
